known_limitations: source contact sheets were irregular and were repacked into exact runtime cells
some down-facing movement and action frames remain three-quarter rather than perfectly frontal
defeat right-facing frames are mirrored from the left-facing row
generated source art includes baked contact shadows
walk motion is improved but still has limited true foot articulation
attack and cast flame effects vary in size and may need hand cleanup
source_note: Second-generation Fire Hatchling canary rebuilt from seven supplied 1536x1024 RGBA contact sheets. Compact 48x48 runtime cells are used for this staged in-world review; the approved production replacement should be exported from the retained 128x128 masters after hand cleanup.
